blocks.content: Now you are ready to create your first save. Run:

[main (root-commit) 4f3a1b2] Add homepage and stylesheet
2 files changed, 45 insertions(+)
That 4f3a1b2 is the commit ID — a unique fingerprint for this save point. The message you wrote is permanently attached to it.
Run git status one more time:
On branch main nothing to commit, working tree clean

blocks.alt: Terminal showing commit output with hash and message, followed by a clean git status

blocks.content: When you see "working tree clean" your save is complete.
